findings.scope: Selected predictor state and documented API
findings.text: SAM 2 keeps per-video inference state, frame dimensions, client object IDs, prompts and per-object results. CPU offload settings trade memory against throughput. The output is segmentation, not reconstruction of hidden backgrounds.

ProPainter takes video or frames plus masks; neighbor/reference/subvideo settings affect memory use. Its published code/model license is non-commercial. It is a study candidate and cannot be admitted as a commercial default from public availability alone.

findings.scope: Published API and license; not executed
findings.text: VTracer offers raster-to-SVG stages and a Node WASM interface with buffer/raw-pixel entrypoints and palette/curve controls. The retrieved root license is MIT. Repository compactness claims have not been independently measured here.

VBench distinguishes standard benchmark prompts from custom-input evaluation; the documented custom path supports a specified subset of dimensions. Temporal-flicker evaluation has a static-video filtering step. Its scores do not certify project intent or commercial readiness.

Shader to RGB registers a Shader input and Color/Alpha outputs with a GPU callback; its registration explicitly limits support to EEVEE. Portability to another renderer requires a separate material strategy and test.

The nested-property keyframe example inserts animation from the owning ID datablock rather than the nested bone. A successful API call does not establish pivot, collision, interpolation or editable-export correctness.

OpenEXR separates display and data windows, channel types, multipart images and variable per-pixel deep samples. The library offers configurable image/tile limits. File format support alone does not prove compositing correctness or bounded memory use.

OCIO configs identify roles, contexts, transforms and viewing choices. The documentation recommends API authoring and ociocheck validation; Config validation and ociocheck differ in role checks. LUT files and context values must accompany a reproducible transform.

The documented core package includes native JSON, directory and ZIP adapters. Other editorial formats use additional adapter packages with varying maintenance. Installing OTIO core does not establish AAF/FCP/Resolve interchange.

USD composes references, layers, variants and payloads with strength ordering. It supports non-destructive scene overrides; topology changes can still invalidate downstream work. MGR must retain its own asset identity and application-specific rigging boundaries.

Photoshop batchPlay may resolve its promise while returning an error result for an action. Document and layer IDs are more stable than array indices within a session. Adapter success must inspect individual results and the resulting document.

Use explicit motion budgets, reduced-motion behavior and measured browser journeys; favor transform/opacity where suitable and inspect actual rendering cost. Validate keyboard use, content access and complete flows separately from animation aesthetics.

findings.text: Ten isolated Creation OS checks exposed missing camera/scene checks and mutable asset lineage. The dossier separates media probing, camera conditioning, simulation caching and editorial timing from rendered verification.

The local companion validates structured plans, locked revisions, dependencies and text-only MiniMax drafts. Optional MCP endpoints are configuration; they do not prove account authorization or successful generation.
